title: Stop deriving restored memory ids from snapshot content fingerprints
outcome: Stop deriving restored memory ids from snapshot content fingerprints
acceptance: Graph load mints a random MemoryId for each restored project-memory chain, uses it consistently in versions and assertion links, and keeps the snapshot body fingerprint only as provenance; tests show equal-content loads do not derive equal memory ids.

completion.summary: Graph load now mints one random MemoryId per restored project-memory chain and shares it across every version and assertion, tombstone included. The fingerprint-derived id is removed, and the fingerprint stays provenance only. Loading the same snapshot twice gives different ids, and stored records keep their ids. Landed as 2a7046c.
